'''Andy Newton''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[May 2000 St. Cloud tournament]] on 20 May 2000 with [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|Carbon Chamber Testing]] and Throne Room, according to Jim Li's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d768">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-21-st-cloud-minnesota-5-20-00d768/ st-cloud-minnesota-5-20-00], DeckTech (Jim "Stimmed Jim" Li, 21 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-21-st-cloud-minnesota-5-20-00d768/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
